about: Round 2's sounds (2026-10-12): S7 the city end, S4 part 2, S3 the Rainbow Bridge, S2 the canal, S1 the countryside. From gen/life/sound_needs_round2.md (where each plays, painted sources, period notes); core.json units are reused by name, not regenerated. Held until the maps show their sources: whip_crack, oar_stroke, paper_goods_rustle, hoe_soil. Dropped: bed_mist_edge (two prompts gave silence, -60 and -68 LUFS); the mist edges play bed_bare_trees_wind low instead.

bed_river_flow.use: The 汴河 under S4b's moorings, S3 and S2, day and night
bed_river_flow.prompt: A broad, slow river flowing past an earthen bank and moored wooden boats: a steady soft current, small gurgles and swirls along the hulls, water moving against the bank, open air with a light breeze. No music, no speech, no engines.

bed_wharf_day.use: Worked banks by day: S2's east bank and terrace, S3's south bank, S4b's moorings (half level)
bed_wharf_day.prompt: A busy riverside wharf by day, heard from the bank: footsteps on wooden planks, heavy sacks thudding down, hemp ropes creaking, wooden hulls knocking softly, water lapping, a low indistinct murmur of workers far off. No music, no speech, no engines.

bed_bridge_crowd.use: The Rainbow Bridge's deck and feet by day
bed_bridge_crowd.prompt: Many people crossing a large arched timber bridge by day: hollow footsteps on thick wooden planks, shuffling cloth shoes, creaking boards, an occasional hoof knock, a river rushing far below, a distant wordless hum of a crowd with no words. No music, no speech, no voices, no engines.
bed_bridge_crowd.note: Take 0 of the first prompt held an English sentence (speech-to-text); prompt rewritten 2026-10-12.

bed_country_day.use: S1 by day: fields, willows, farmhouses
bed_country_day.prompt: Open farmland in early spring by day: a light breeze over bare fields and leafless trees, swallows twittering, tree sparrows by a farmhouse, a magpie chattering far off, wide quiet open air. No music, no speech, no engines.

hull_creak.use: Every moored or working boat; pitched down for the deep-laden grain boats
hull_creak.prompt: A large old wooden boat hull creaking slowly as it shifts against its mooring, one long deep groan of timber, close, dry.

hull_water_slap.use: Water against hulls: moored, under way, S1's possible skiff
hull_water_slap.prompt: Four separate small river waves slapping against the side of a moored wooden boat hull, hollow wet knocks with short gaps, close, dry.

mooring_rope_creak.use: S4b's mooring post and anchor line, S2's post with the coiled rope, moored boats
mooring_rope_creak.prompt: A thick hemp mooring rope tightening twice around a wooden post under load, creaking and squeaking stretch, close, dry.

sweep_scull.use: 摇橹向前 (S3), the boats under way in S2: one stroke, sequenced
sweep_scull.prompt: One stroke of a long wooden stern sweep oar sculling a heavy river boat: the wooden pivot creaking, the blade swishing through the water, close, dry.

mast_lower.use: 大船抢险 under the arch (S3), once per cycle
mast_lower.prompt: A tall wooden boat mast being lowered: heavy timber creaking and groaning as it tilts, ropes straining, then a dull heavy wooden thud on the deck, close, dry.

rope_haul.use: The big boat's crew (S3), mooring work, boats setting off
rope_haul.prompt: Two strong hand-over-hand pulls on a thick hemp rope, the rope rasping and squeaking under tension, close, dry.

horse_gallop_earth.use: 惊马闯市's runaway horse (S1), while it runs
horse_gallop_earth.prompt: A loose horse galloping fast on packed earth, heavy drumming hooves, a snort, outdoors, close, dry.

wheelwright_mallet.use: 车铺劳作 (S4b.fig.wheelwright_bending_13620), on the strike frame
wheelwright_mallet.prompt: Three separate strikes of a wooden mallet on the hub of a wooden cart wheel, solid resonant knocks on hard timber, outdoors, close, dry.

bed_open_night.use: Night outside the walls (S4b, S3, S2, S1), replacing the summer `bed_night` there
bed_open_night.prompt: Open land by water on a cool early-spring night: still air, a faint breeze, a few frogs croaking far off, very sparse insects, wide and quiet, no summer cricket chorus. No music, no speech, no engines.

bed_bare_trees_wind.use: Leafless elms and shoots: S1, S7's cut edge, S4b's and S3's bare trees
bed_bare_trees_wind.prompt: Wind through tall leafless trees in early spring: dry twigs ticking and clattering softly, branches creaking, an airy whoosh rising and falling, no leaves, outdoors. No music, no speech, no engines.

stream_trickle.use: S1's stream and the small bridge (point bed)
stream_trickle.prompt: A small shallow stream trickling over pebbles and around wooden bridge posts in open country: gentle bubbling and babbling, soft and close, calm air. No music, no speech, no engines.

river_swift.use: The current at the Rainbow Bridge's abutments and under the arch; 汴水悍激 (S2 pin 7)
river_swift.prompt: A strong river current rushing past timber bridge abutments and wooden piles: fast swirling water, eddies gurgling and sucking, a deep steady rush, outdoors, mid distance. No music, no speech, no engines.

hull_bump.prompt: Two moored wooden boat hulls bumping together twice, heavy dull wooden knocks with a short grinding rub, close, dry.

pole_push.use: Fending off the arch (S3), S2's poling boats, boats setting off
pole_push.prompt: A long bamboo punting pole plunged into a river and pushed hard against the bottom from a wooden boat: a splash, bamboo creaking under strain, water dripping, close, dry.

rope_throw.use: 上下呼救: ropes thrown from the railings (S3)
rope_throw.prompt: A coiled hemp rope thrown through the air with a soft whoosh, then slapping down onto a wooden boat deck, close, dry.

tow_rope_strain.use: The tow lines: S3's masted boat, S2's 逆水行舟 (at the trackers and at the mast)
tow_rope_strain.prompt: A very long taut hemp tow rope under heavy strain outdoors, slow creaking and stretching groans, a light twang as it tightens, close, dry.

tracker_strain.use: The trackers (S3.grp.trackers_16380; S2's five): wordless effort, reject takes with words
tracker_strain.prompt: Several men leaning into a heavy tow rope together: deep rhythmic effort breaths and low wordless grunts, feet scraping on earth, outdoors, close, dry.

step_boat_deck.use: The player or crew on a boat deck (if the pilot opens decks)
step_boat_deck.prompt: Four footsteps in cloth shoes on the plank deck of a floating wooden boat, hollow boomy knocks with a slight creak and faint water slosh under the hull, close, dry.

gangplank_flex.use: S4b's plank to the mat-cargo boat, S2's gangplank, S3's unloading boats
gangplank_flex.prompt: Two footsteps on a long wooden gangplank between a boat and a bank, the board bending with a springy creak and a hollow knock, close, dry.

step_mud.use: Wet bank mud at every shore (S4b, S3, S2) and S1's stream
step_mud.prompt: Four footsteps in cloth shoes on wet, sticky river-bank mud, a soft squelch and suck as each foot pulls free, close, dry.

bridge_arch_creak.use: The Rainbow Bridge under its crowd and under the player
bridge_arch_creak.prompt: A huge timber arch bridge under the weight of a crowd: massive wooden beams creaking and groaning deeply, low knocks in the joints, outdoors, close, dry.

hooves_timber.use: 车轿相争's horseman on the deck; any animal on a bridge
hooves_timber.prompt: A horse stamping and shifting on a thick timber bridge deck, four hollow hoof knocks on wooden planks, close, dry.

crowd_alarm.use: 上下呼救's peak on the bridge (S3), wordless; reject takes with words
crowd_alarm.prompt: A crowd on a bridge crying out in alarm together, a sudden rising wordless clamour of many voices, outdoors, close, dry, no intelligible words.

cart_two_wheel_earth.use: Moving two-wheeled carts without a bell: S4b's palm cart 13455, S3's and S2's north-bank carts
cart_two_wheel_earth.prompt: A large two-wheeled wooden cart rolling slowly on a dirt road: big wooden wheels crunching grit, the wooden axle creaking and knocking with each turn, no bell, close, dry.

pannier_creak.use: S1's charcoal donkeys, S3's loaded donkey (while walking)
pannier_creak.prompt: A donkey walking with two heavy wicker panniers of charcoal on a wooden pack saddle: wicker and wood creaking with each step, lumps of charcoal shifting, close, dry.

mule_call.use: S4b's pack mules, S2's mule cart (if a mule)
mule_call.prompt: A mule calling once, a whinny that breaks into a hoarse bray, outdoors, close, dry.

bucket_slosh.use: S7.fig.bucket_man_1872 at the well's west end
bucket_slosh.prompt: A full wooden water bucket lifted and set down, water sloshing and the bail handle creaking, close, dry.

sack_shoulder.use: 私粮进京's porters (S2), S3's unloading
sack_shoulder.prompt: A porter heaving a heavy grain sack onto his shoulder: coarse hemp cloth rubbing, grain shifting and settling inside, close, dry.

railing_creak.use: The bridge railings: leaners and the player
railing_creak.prompt: Someone leaning on an old wooden bridge railing: the rail creaks and its post knocks softly, close, dry.

scaffold_creak.use: 十千脚店's 彩楼欢门 scaffold (S3), S2's roof scaffold, in gusts
scaffold_creak.prompt: Tall wooden poles lashed together with rope, creaking and knocking softly as a gust pushes them, outdoors, close, dry.

wind_vane_turn.use: The bird vane on the 新酒 pole (S3), and the bridge's end posts if vaned
wind_vane_turn.prompt: A small wooden wind vane swinging on a squeaky wooden pivot atop a tall pole in a gust, outdoors, close, dry.

twig_brush.use: Walking into bare shoots and saplings (S1, S7, S3)
twig_brush.prompt: Clothes brushing through dry leafless twigs and bare shoots: light scratching and small snapping ticks, close, dry.

straw_reed_brush.use: Thatch, reed fences and mats, wattle, palm-cart fringes (S4b, S1)
straw_reed_brush.prompt: A sleeve brushing along dry straw thatch, a reed mat screen and a woven wattle fence: dry rustle, rattle and scrape, close, dry.

wood_bump.use: Bumping signboards (S7's boards), leaning poles and timber (S4b), the scaffold (S3)
wood_bump.prompt: Two separate bumps against a free-standing wooden signboard and a stack of leaning poles: hollow wooden knocks and a short rattle, close, dry.

jar_knock.use: Bumping big jars and barrels (S4b's big jar, taverns)
jar_knock.prompt: A shoulder bumping a big glazed earthenware storage jar, three separate hollow ceramic thunks, close, dry.

step_splash.use: Ankle-deep water at open shores and S1's stream
step_splash.prompt: Three footsteps splashing through ankle-deep water at a muddy stream edge, close, dry.
